source: PhilGEPS (Procurement Service-DBM) open tenders bulletin: 'View More Open Tenders' search
count_method: POST to https://philgeps.gov.ph/Indexes/viewMoreOpenTenders with form field searchKeyword=<term> plus the page's _csrfToken and session cookie (GET the page first). The result page prints 'showing 20 record(s) out of N total'; parse N. Tested 2026-10-05: software=57, ERP=31, hospital=86, 'core banking'=0; unfiltered=7,097. Covers OPEN tenders only (a point-in-time snapshot, not history). Other filters: searchAreaDel, searchPublishDateFrom/To, searchBudgetFrom/To. Pagination: /indexes/view-more-open-tenders?page=N.
robots_or_terms: https://philgeps.gov.ph/robots.txt has no robots file. It returns the HTML homepage, which carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">. notices.philgeps.gov.ph/robots.txt returns 404. No API or terms covering automated access were found. The open.philgeps.gov.ph Terms link (termsAndConditionsBuyer.php) returned 404.
notes: Best free procurement source for counts. No official API. The keyword probably matches notice titles only (ERP=31 suggests substring matches). Count manually before relying on it. A POST to the main /Indexes/index form with searchNoticeTitle returned an HTTP 500 error page, so use the viewMoreOpenTenders form. The legacy ASP.NET portal (notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/...) uses __doPostBack. Its category view shows per-category open counts (for example '153 categories found', Catering Services [562]) but no keyword total.

source: PhilGEPS award notices (getAwardNotices) and former opportunities (getFormerOpportunities)
count_method: No total is printed. The award search form has searchAwardNoticeNo, searchRefNo and searchLineItem (Award Title). My test POSTs with searchLineItem/searchKeyword returned rows but no 'out of N total' string. To get a count you would have to paginate and count rows yourself. Unverified beyond that.
robots_or_terms: Same host as above: no robots.txt, homepage meta noindex,nofollow, no published terms on automated access found.
notes: Historical (awarded) contracts are what show who bought a core banking, ERP or hospital system. This source can't give a total in one query. Former opportunities (https://philgeps.gov.ph/Indexes/getFormerOpportunities) has Notice Title and Agency Name fields. Same caveat: no total observed.

source: PhilGEPS Open Data analytics (open.philgeps.gov.ph)
count_method: Aggregate dashboards only: Yearly Tender Summary, Bid Notice Result per Month, Bid Notice Distribution, Top Agencies, and searches for Merchant and Agency general info. No keyword-level count over notice text was found. No CSV, JSON or API was visible on the page.
robots_or_terms: open.philgeps.gov.ph/robots.txt returns 404 (no rules). Terms link https://open.philgeps.gov.ph/termsAndConditionsBuyer.php returned 404. Page disclaimer only disclaims accuracy.
notes: Useful for denominators (registered agencies, total bid notices per year), not keyword counts. A web search snippet claimed CSV/JSON/Excel export, but I did not see it on the page, so treat that as unverified.

source: Kalibrr job board (public JSON search endpoint)
count_method: GET https://www.kalibrr.com/kjs/job_board/search?limit=1&offset=0&text=<term>&country=Philippines returns JSON with a 'count' field. Check 'from_alternative': true means no exact match and the count is a fallback/fuzzy result. Tested 2026-10-05: COBOL=1, AS400=1, 'core banking'=90, SAP=26, mainframe=795 but from_alternative=true (so mainframe is really ~0).
robots_or_terms: robots.txt (https://www.kalibrr.com/robots.txt) only disallows /root and /candidate/profile for User-agent *. Terms (https://www.kalibrr.com/terms) prohibit unauthorized access, and the platform monitors to prevent 'automated extraction, scraping'. Robots allows it, but the ToS discourages it. Keep volume low or ask for permission.
notes: Undocumented internal endpoint (not a published API), so it may change. Snapshot of current openings only. Must handle the from_alternative flag or counts will be badly inflated.

source: JobStreet Philippines (SEEK)
count_method: The site shows 'N jobs' on keyword pages such as https://ph.jobstreet.com/COBOL-jobs, but both WebFetch (HTTP 403) and curl got a Cloudflare 'Just a moment... Enable JavaScript and cookies' challenge. I could not see a count string. No free API.
robots_or_terms: robots.txt: User-agent * disallows '*?', /graphql and /api/jobsearch/, and allows '*?keywords'. anthropic-ai, GPTBot and CCBot are disallowed from /companies and */job/. Terms (https://ph.jobstreet.com/terms) cl. 7(d) bans data mining, robots and screen scraping without written permission. Cl. 9(b) bans automated querying except through provided interfaces. Cl. 9(d) bans circumventing rate limits and fingerprinting. Not usable for automated counts without permission.
notes: Largest PH job board, but only usable manually (a person reading the count in a browser) or under a partnership. The bot challenge blocks programmatic access.

source: Indeed Philippines
count_method: None usable. Search URL https://ph.indeed.com/jobs?q=COBOL returned a 'Security Check' captcha page to curl, so no count was visible.
robots_or_terms: robots.txt for User-agent * has 'Disallow: /jobs', 'Disallow: /m/jobs' and 'Disallow: /q-'. Search results are explicitly off-limits to crawlers. Legal page (https://ph.indeed.com/legal) bans bots for Indeed Apply and reserves the right to limit use.
notes: Exclude from automated collection. Listed so the study records why it is excluded.

source: PhilJobNet (DOLE Bureau of Local Employment official job portal)
count_method: ASP.NET form on /job-vacancies/ with field ctl00$BodyContentPlaceHolder$searchterm (search by position title or employer) and category checkboxes. My postback with searchterm=programmer returned the page with no result-count text and no job rows parsed. No way to get a total was found. Unverified.
robots_or_terms: https://philjobnet.gov.ph/robots.txt returns 'resource ... removed' (no robots file). No terms on automated access were found.
notes: Government source, so primary. It mostly covers PESO and accredited-employer jobs, which are likely sparse for COBOL/AS400. Might need a real browser to see the result count.

source: BSP Directory of Banks and Non-Bank Financial Institutions, plus BSP Statistics Table 23 (Number of Financial Institutions)
count_method: Not a keyword source. It's a denominator register. Table 23 gives counts by type: 2026 has 44 universal/commercial bank head offices, 42 thrift and 366 rural/cooperative, total establishments 31,009. Directory page filters by 'Type of Financial Institution'. The list is loaded client-side, and curl got a 430-byte Akamai block. Separate PDF lists exist (e.g., trust-authority list at /Lists/Directories/Attachments/3/trust1.pdf).
robots_or_terms: https://www.bsp.gov.ph/robots.txt returned Akamai 'Access Denied' to curl, so robots rules could not be read. No terms on automated access were found. Table 23: https://www.bsp.gov.ph/Statistics/Financial%20System%20Accounts/tab23_nfi.aspx (no Excel link seen).
notes: Use it to list all banks (the universe for core-banking adoption). Programmatic access is blocked by the CDN, so download manually.

source: Insurance Commission: List of Insurance Companies with Valid and Existing Certificate of Authority
count_method: Download the PDF and count rows per section (I. Composite, II. Life, III. Non-life, ...). The Feb 2025 edition is 3 pages, OCR-quality text (pdftotext works with typos). The Composite section lists 7 companies. No keyword search.
robots_or_terms: www.insurance.gov.ph/robots.txt sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge ('Just a moment...'), so I couldn't read it. The PDF itself downloaded through WebFetch. No terms on reuse were found.
notes: Denominator for insurer core/policy-admin systems. Look on the IC site for a newer monthly edition. The URL is dated, so editions change.

source: DOH National Health Facility Registry (NHFR)
count_method: Per a web search snippet (not verified by me): Facility List, then Health Facility Type = Hospital, then Search, then Export to Excel/CSV, and count rows. My WebFetch got HTTP 403 and curl got a Cloudflare 'Attention Required' block, so no count was verified.
robots_or_terms: https://nhfr.doh.gov.ph/robots.txt returned a Cloudflare block page, so it couldn't be read. No evidence on terms.
notes: Primary register of hospitals (denominator for hospital information systems). Export likely needs a real browser. FOI requests for hospital lists also exist on foi.gov.ph, which also returned 403 to me.

source: PSE EDGE company announcements (Philippine Stock Exchange disclosure system)
count_method: POST https://edge.pse.com.ph/announcements/search.ax with keyword=<term>&pageNo=1&companyId=&tmplNm=&fromDate=MM-DD-YYYY&toDate=MM-DD-YYYY&sortType=. The response HTML contains '[Total N]'. Dates appear to be required: an empty date range returned no Total. Tested 01-01-2024 to 10-05-2026: Bank=1,875, system=48, 'core banking'=0. The keyword seems to match company or template names, not full disclosure text.
robots_or_terms: https://edge.pse.com.ph/robots.txt returns JBoss 404 (no robots file). Disclaimer (https://edge.pse.com.ph/page/disclaimer.do) says you may NOT copy, store in an electronic retrieval system, reproduce, redistribute, etc. That restricts storing or republishing the content. A count query is a grey area, so confirm with the PSE.
notes: Only listed companies (about 280). Full-text vendor mentions (e.g., 'core banking system migration') need opening the PDFs. The search won't count them.

source: SEC Philippines 'Check with SEC' company verification
count_method: None verified. The portal returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge to curl. Per web search it is a single-entity lookup by name or registration number, not a bulk register, so it gives no keyword totals.
robots_or_terms: robots.txt is behind a Cloudflare challenge and couldn't be read. No terms were found.
notes: Not suitable for counts. Bulk company registers in PH are paid or request-based (SEC eSEARCH document purchase). Use it only to verify individual organisations found by the other sources.

source: AusTender OCDS API (Australian Government contract notices, Department of Finance)
count_method: There is no keyword parameter and no total-count field. Call GET https://api.tenders.gov.au/ocds/findByDates/contractPublished/{startISO}/{endISO}. It returns 100 releases per page with a links.next cursor (keys: uri, publisher, publishedDate, license, version, releases, extensions, links). Follow links.next until it runs out, then count releases whose contracts[].description matches the keyword (e.g. 'mainframe', 'COBOL', 'SAP', 'core banking') or whose items[].classification UNSPSC code matches (e.g. 4323xxxx software, 8111xxxx IT services). Group by the parties[] entry with role procuringEntity (it carries an ABN) to count organisations.
robots_or_terms: API responses declare license CC BY 3.0 AU. The API root returns 'Missing Authentication Token', but the findByDates endpoints answered with no key. www.tenders.gov.au/robots.txt has 'Disallow: /Search/*', '/Reports/*', '/Cn/List*', '/Son/List*' for all agents, so automated keyword counts through the website search are disallowed. Use the API instead. Fetched from api.tenders.gov.au on 2026-10-05.
notes: This is the best Commonwealth source of buyer, supplier, description, UNSPSC and value for each contract over AUD 10k. Descriptions are short, so keyword recall is low. Pair the keywords with UNSPSC codes and supplier names (e.g. known mainframe or ERP integrators). WebFetch got HTTP 403, so these checks used curl with a browser user agent.

source: data.gov.au: Historical Australian Government Contract Data (AusTender CNs 1999-2020) and the AusTender Contract Notice Export
count_method: Download the zipped CSVs listed under package_show?id=historical-australian-government-contract-data (19 resources, e.g. austenderallcnsupto19sep16.zip and gapscontractexport.zip). Filter the description and UNSPSC columns for the keywords, then count rows, or count distinct agencies. CKAN package_search returns result.count, but that counts datasets, not contracts.
robots_or_terms: Licence CC BY 3.0 AU. data.gov.au/robots.txt is 'User-agent: * Disallow: /', which covers crawling of the whole host including the CKAN API path. The API is public and documented, but a strict robots-compliant crawler should limit itself to one-off downloads of the listed files.
notes: Historical backfill only. The contract-notice-export dataset's resources date from 2013 (weekly XLS files), and its notes say new weekly exports come from AusTender itself and stay there for 18 months. Use the OCDS API for anything recent.

source: NSW eTendering OCDS data (NSW Treasury) via the Open Contracting Data Registry
count_method: Download the 'all time' JSONL, CSV or XLSX from the registry page. Count releases where tender/award/contract title or description matches the keyword, and group by buyer for organisation counts. The registry shows 29,391 tenders and 15,941 awards. The legacy keyword API (tenders.nsw.gov.au/?event=public.api.contract.search&keyword=...) is documented on GitHub, but on 2026-10-05 it redirected to the buy.nsw.gov.au homepage and returned no results, so it no longer gives live counts.
robots_or_terms: Licence CC BY 3.0 AU (per the registry). The legacy API repo says requests are rate limited by IP. buy.nsw.gov.au/robots.txt has 'Disallow: /search'. tenders.nsw.gov.au/robots.txt disallows only *cnStep2* and *advancedsearch*. I did not check robots.txt for data.open-contracting.org.
notes: Covers Dec 2005 to Feb 2025. The registry says the publisher no longer updates it. API documentation: https://github.com/NSW-eTendering/NSW-eTendering-API/wiki. No free live NSW source was confirmed after the move to buy.nsw.

source: APRA registers (ADIs, general insurers, life insurers, private health insurers, superannuation)
count_method: Each register is a single HTML table, so the count is the number of rows (the ADI register looked like 130+ entities, updated 10 Aug 2026). There is no keyword search. This source gives the full list of regulated banks and insurers to use as the denominator, not keyword hits. I found no xlsx or csv links on the ADI or general insurer register pages.
robots_or_terms: I saw the start of apra.gov.au/robots.txt: it is a standard Drupal file with Allow rules for /core assets and Disallow rules further down that I did not read in full. The footer shows Copyright APRA. I found no specific licence for reusing the registers.
notes: Also opened: https://www.apra.gov.au/register-of-authorised-deposit-taking-institutions. Use it to build the list of banks and insurers, then join it to the procurement and job sources by name or ABN.

source: ASIC Company Dataset (data.gov.au)
count_method: Download the monthly CSV (e.g. company_202609.csv or the .zip). Count rows where Company Name contains a term (e.g. HOSPITAL, INSURANCE, BANK) and filter by status and type columns (see the help-file PDF). There is no API keyword count.
robots_or_terms: Licence CC BY 3.0 AU. data.gov.au robots.txt is 'Disallow: /' for all agents (see the historical contract data entry).
notes: Lists companies only and has no industry code. Use it to resolve names to ACN or ABN and to build denominators. It does not show which software a company runs.

source: ABN Bulk Extract (data.gov.au) and ABN Lookup web services (ABR)
count_method: Bulk: download public_split_1_10.zip and public_split_11_20.zip (XML, XSD provided), parse, and count ABNs whose entity name or entity type matches. Web services: name search by keyword with a free GUID. Its maximum result count was not stated on the page, so do not treat it as an exact total.
robots_or_terms: Web services are free but need registration and acceptance of the web services agreement (authentication GUID). The bulk extract on data.gov.au is CC BY 3.0 AU (https://data.gov.au/data/api/3/action/package_search?q=abn%20bulk%20extract). data.gov.au robots.txt disallows all agents.
notes: Useful as a join key, because AusTender OCDS parties carry AU-ABN identifiers. That lets you link procuring entities and suppliers to bank, insurer and hospital lists.

source: AIHW MyHospitals Data API (hospital register)
count_method: GET https://myhospitalsapi.aihw.gov.au/api/v1/reporting-units?reporting_unit_type=H and count result[]. On 2026-10-05 it returned 1,428 hospital units, 1,352 with closed=false. Filter by the private flag and mapped_reporting_units (LHN, state). The reporting_unit_name field allows name keyword filters. The OpenAPI spec is at /swagger/v1/swagger.json.
robots_or_terms: The spec's info.license says CC BY 3.0 (aihw.gov.au/copyright). myhospitalsapi.aihw.gov.au/robots.txt returns 404, so there is no robots file. No key was needed.
notes: This is the denominator for hospitals, with LHN mapping (LHNs are often the buyers of patient administration systems). It has no software data, so join it to AusTender or state procurement by LHN or health department name.

source: ACNC Registered Charities dataset (data.gov.au)
count_method: Download datadotgov_main.csv or .xlsx (metadata modified 2026-10-04). Count rows whose charity name or subtype or purpose columns match (e.g. hospital, health, mutual), using the user-notes PDF for column definitions.
robots_or_terms: Licence CC BY 3.0 AU. data.gov.au robots.txt disallows all agents.
notes: Covers non-profit hospitals, health services and some mutuals that are missing from APRA and ASIC lists. It is a register only and has no technology data.

source: SEEK (seek.com.au)
count_method: In a browser, open https://www.seek.com.au/<keyword>-jobs (e.g. /cobol-jobs, /mainframe-jobs, /as400-jobs) and read the total job count in the results header. This was not verified: a scripted request on 2026-10-05 got a Cloudflare managed challenge page instead of results.
robots_or_terms: robots.txt for User-agent * disallows '*/job/', '*?' (except '*?keywords' and '*?advertiserid'), '/graphql' and '/api/jobsearch/'. It names anthropic-ai and GPTBot with 'Disallow: /companies' and '*/job/'. The terms (https://www.seek.com.au/terms), clause d, ban data mining, robots, screen scraping and similar automated extraction tools. Treat SEEK as manual spot-checks only.
notes: The largest AU job board and the best signal for COBOL, AS400 and mainframe skills demand, but there is no free API and the terms forbid automated counts.

source: Indeed Australia (au.indeed.com)
count_method: In a browser, open https://au.indeed.com/jobs?q=<keyword> and read the 'N jobs' count on the results page. This was not verified: a scripted request returned HTTP 403.
robots_or_terms: robots.txt for User-agent * starts with 'Allow: /' and allows start= paging up to 90. It disallows /api/getrecjobs, /advanced_search, /alert and country paths like /jobs/AU/. I did not open Indeed's terms of service, so I have no evidence on what they allow.
notes: Use for manual cross-checks against SEEK. Bot blocking stops automated counts.

source: APSJobs (Australian Public Service jobs)
count_method: Not verified. https://www.apsjobs.gov.au/s/job-search?searchString=<keyword> is a JavaScript-only Salesforce Experience site, and the fetched HTML had no result count. The count can only be read in a real browser. Another route is to enumerate job pages from the sitemap at /s/sitemap.xml and count the keyword matches yourself.
robots_or_terms: robots.txt is the Salesforce communities default: 'User-agent: * Allow: /', disallowing only */secur/forgotpassword.jsp. It lists the sitemap at https://www.apsjobs.gov.au/s/sitemap.xml. I did not review the terms of use.
notes: Covers Commonwealth agency hiring (e.g. Services Australia, ATO, Defence), which is useful for government legacy-system skills. I also tried Workforce Australia (https://www.workforceaustralia.gov.au/individuals/jobs/search?searchText=cobol): it showed 'Problem loading the job search app', curl could not connect, and I found no official API (only third-party Apify scrapers), so it is left out.

source: Apple iTunes Lookup + Customer Reviews RSS
count_method: GET https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=<apple_id>&country=<cc> returns one results row per app x storefront: averageUserRating, userRatingCount, version, currentVersionReleaseDate. GET https://itunes.apple.com/<cc>/rss/customerreviews/page=<n>/id=<apple_id>/sortby=<sort>/json returns up to 50 reviews per page (id, im:rating, updated, title, content, link). Tested live 2026-10-05: lookup worked for every app tried; the review feed is degraded. sortby=mostrecent returned an empty feed.entry for every app and storefront tried (US, GB, SG). sortby=mosthelpful served page 1 only (page 2+ empty), intermittently, and only for a minority of apps; WhatsApp returned 50 entries once, then 0 on later identical requests.
robots_or_terms: itunes.apple.com/robots.txt declares Disallow: /*/rss/* and Disallow: /*/lookup? for User-agent: *. Those are RFC 9309 wildcard rules that urllib.robotparser reads as literal prefixes, so the repo's robots gate permits both endpoints; under wildcard semantics the root /lookup path is not matched either, but /*/rss/* does cover the reviews feed. No API key or login needed. No explicit terms-of-use page found.
notes: Lane M (plan 3). The feed degradation means app_reviews items will be sparse until Apple serves the feed again; lsa apps --sort mosthelpful is the working fallback while mostrecent is empty. apps.parquet (rating, count, version date) is unaffected.
